author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner list shows the first page for a page number below 1
summary: A request for the owner list with a page number of 0 or below shows the first page as the normal listing, instead of the error page.
acceptance_criteria: Given GET /owners?page=0, when it is handled, then the response is HTTP 200 and renders the normal owner list showing the first page, not the error page.
Given GET /owners with any negative page (e.g. page=-1, page=-5), when it is handled, then the response matches the same request with page=1: HTTP 200, the owner list view, the first page of owners.
Given a page number below 1, when the owner list renders, then page 1 is presented as the current page.

Given a page number below 1 on a last-name search matching exactly one owner, when it runs, then that owner's record opens as it does for page=1; with no match, the search reports that no owner was found (PRD Owner records edge case 4).
A regression test drives /owners with page values below 1 through the web layer and fails against the pre-fix code.
non_goals: Page values that are not a number (e.g. page=abc): outside the quoted intake, left open in the PRD Open Questions.
Page numbers past the last page: outside the quoted intake, left open in the PRD Open Questions.
Paging of the veterinarian directory: the intake names only the owner listing.
notes: Grounded in intake-decision line 1 (decisions: none; the request states the expected behavior). Observed cause: the one-based page number becomes a zero-based page index with no lower bound, so page 0 or below yields a negative index the paging request rejects. Normalizing a request parameter is web-controller binding (docs/architecture-principles.md), tested at the web level (docs/testing-principles.md). theOwnerListShouldShowTheFirstPageWhenThePageIsBelowOne is one data-driven test over 0 and negative values. Autofix audit: no prd-autofix records. The veterinarian directory's paging likely shares the pattern; it is outside this slice and untouched.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Covered by docs/architecture-principles.md pattern catalog, Web controller row: normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding, not a business rule, so the clamp belongs in the owner search handler and nowhere else. The OwnerController contract row in docs/system-design.md § Contracts already owns search with paging; REQ-OWN-005 now joins its Implements cell. Basis: no IDE oracle connected, so this rests on a direct read of OwnerController.java (weaker basis than symbol resolution). processFindForm binds @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") int page. findPaginatedForOwnersLastName passes page - 1 to PageRequest.of, which rejects a negative index, and that failure renders the error page. addPaginationModel publishes the raw page as currentPage. No new type, module, constant, or pattern is needed.
integration_points: Binding (existing entry point, no new one): GET /owners binds page as a request-scoped scalar via @RequestParam. The fix clamps it to at least 1 once, at the top of processFindForm, before any use. No persisted type is bound by the change.
Framework transport double: MockMvc under the existing @WebMvcTest(OwnerController.class) slice, the sanctioned transport stand-in (docs/testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy).

Repository double: reuse the class's existing @MockitoBean OwnerRepository fixture. This is a conscious framework-stub exception per docs/testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy. A hand-written double would have to implement the whole Spring Data repository interface for one derived query, and a real repository would move the test out of the web slice. Stub findByLastNameStartingWith per test as the adjacent processFindForm tests do. No new stub target beyond that method.

patterns.description: processFindFormSuccess / processFindFormByLastName / processFindFormNoOwnersFound: the MockMvc shape for the list (multiple owners), single-match redirect, and no-match cases the acceptance criteria reuse with page values below 1
verify(...).findByLastNameStartingWith(...) pattern; use it to assert the repository receives page index 0 for a page below 1, matching the page=1 request

risks.risk: Clamping only the pageable argument while addPaginationModel still receives the raw value presents page 0 or a negative as the current page, which breaks the acceptance criterion that page 1 is presented as current.
risks.mitigation: Normalize once at handler entry and feed the one normalized value to both the query and the pagination model (docs/architecture-principles.md, Web controller row: normalization is binding, done once at the boundary). The test asserts model attribute currentPage equals 1.

risks.risk: Arithmetic on an extreme bound value such as page=Integer.MIN_VALUE: computing page - 1 before clamping would overflow.
risks.mitigation: Clamp before subtracting (Math.max(page, 1), then page - 1). Include a large negative in the data-driven test values (docs/security-principles.md § Trust Boundaries: validate the untrusted query parameter where it crosses in).

risks.risk: Scope creep into the shared paging shape: VetController has the same page - 1 arithmetic, and non-numeric or past-the-end pages are open questions.
risks.mitigation: Touch only OwnerController. The prd-entry non_goals exclude vet paging, non-numeric pages, and pages past the end. No shared helper or constant is extracted for a single call site.

notes: Autofix audit: no design-doc-autofix records in the log; nothing to judge. Design-doc write: docs/system-design.md § Contracts, OwnerController row Implements cell gains REQ-OWN-005 (contracts-sync). No ADR: a single-slice choice with no trade-off (adr-template § When to Create an ADR). The regression test fails against pre-fix code by construction, because PageRequest.of throws on a negative index before the repository is reached.
